# Icon

```tsx
import { figmaIcon, HugeiconsIcon } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

## Figma notes

The Figma icons are drawn with a 1.8 stroke on the 24×24 grid (1.2px at 16px, 1.5px at 20px, 1.8px at 24px); Hugeicons ships 1.5. Import HugeiconsIcon from here instead of @hugeicons/react to get the Figma stroke.

Parts:
- `HugeiconsIcon`: HugeiconsIcon with the Figma 1.8 stroke (on the 24×24 grid). An explicit `strokeWidth` still wins.

## Types

`HugeiconsIconProps`, `IconSvgElement`

## Rules

- Import `HugeiconsIcon` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
